name: goal-creator-proactive
context: Agent systems where the agent infers goals proactively from context — not from an explicit user request but from environmental signals, historical patterns, or implicit cues. The agent acts as a proactive assistant, anticipating what the user needs before being asked, based on situation awareness and learned user preferences.
benefits: Reduces friction for the user by anticipating needs without explicit prompting
Enables agents to take initiative in ambient intelligence scenarios
Can surface goals the user did not know they had
Improves user experience by reducing the number of explicit commands needed
tradeoffs: Risk of acting on misinferred goals — acting without confirmation can be disruptive
Proactive inference requires access to contextual signals (calendar, history, sensors)
False positives waste resources on unnecessary actions
Users may feel surveilled if the inference feels opaque
use_cases: Calendar agent: infers from meeting notes that a follow-up task was created and proactively schedules it
Research assistant: notices the user has been reading papers on topic X and surfaces related work
DevOps agent: detects an unusual traffic pattern and proposes a scaling action before being asked
Personal assistant: infers from email tone that a customer is frustrated and suggests an主动道歉
avoid_when: The domain requires explicit user authorization before any action
Inference signals are sparse or unreliable — the agent would act on noise
User privacy constraints prohibit the contextual data needed for inference
anti_patterns: Acting on inferred goals without confirmation in high-stakes domains
Proposing actions the user has previously declined
Inferring goals from a single ambiguous signal without corroboration
design_principles: Proactive recommendations must be confirmable before irreversible actions are taken
The inference chain should be explainable — the agent should be able to say why it inferred this goal
Users must be able to opt out of proactive inference without losing core functionality
best_practices: Start with low-stakes, easily revocable proactive suggestions
Require confirmation for any action that has external side effects
Track user feedback on proactive suggestions to improve inference over time
references: Lu et al., Agent Design Pattern Catalogue, 2024 (arXiv:2405.10467) — https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.10467
